title: CoordinateSectionProjection
statement: Let $P$ be finite purity coefficient data [def-pur-conventions], let $n\geq0$ denote coefficient level $n+1$, and let $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$. For a scheme $B$, write $X_r=\mathbf A^r_B$, $q_r:X_{r+1}\to X_r$ and its closed zero section $s_r$ [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-pur-affine-space-coordinate-boundaries], and $W_r=A_{X_r}(r)[2r]$ with the ordered tensor coordinates [def-pur-affine-space-thom-map]. Define the canonical coefficient-unit and factorwise Tate pullback identifications. Define $\pi_r:s_{r!}A_{X_r}\otimes q_r^*W_r\to s_{r!}W_r$ as the specified proper projection transformation [lem-weil-finite-compact-projection-formula] followed by $s_r^*q_r^*=1$ and the coefficient unitor. Use the closed immersion's proper compactification and the same canonical derived tensor throughout. The underlying derived tensor bifunctor at any commutative coefficient ring $R$ has object part $M\otimes^L N$ for the canonical monoidal structure; the finite supported-cup tensor uses that same structure. The section tensor normalization is obtained from the coefficient unitor and pullback composition $s^*q^*=1$, and the coefficient and Tate pullback identifications are their canonical monoidal comparisons.
